manaNeeded: {0} plus the mana cost of the creature in your hand
easyPrerequisites: Lumbering Battlement must be exiled by Hostage Taker, and Changeling Hero must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
description:
Cast Changeling Hero for its mana cost.
When Changeling Hero enters, it exiles Hostage Taker until Changeling Hero leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Changeling Hero's ETB.
When Hostage Taker leaves the battlefield, Lumbering Battlement is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Lumbering Battlement enters, it exiles Changeling Hero until Lumbering Battlement leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Lumbering Battlement's ETB.
When Changeling Hero leaves the battlefield, Hostage Taker is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Hostage Taker enters, it exiles Lumbering Battlement until Hostage Taker leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Hostage Taker's ETB.
When Lumbering Battlement leaves the battlefield, Changeling Hero is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
